jobs.name: News digest: robotics / defense / physical AI (7am weekdays)
jobs.prompt:
Daily news digest email for the owner. The JSON in the attached script output is TODAY'S refreshed findings from the last30days watch lanes, already ranked and grouped into lanes: ROBOTICS (with sub-lane Humanoid), PHYSICAL AI, DEFENSE DEMAND, NEAR-SHORE / ON-SHORE MFG, SUPPLY-BASE CHOKEPOINTS, CAPITAL / DEAL FLOW, POLICY, CHINA THREATS.

Compose ONE email and send it from the agent mailbox via mcp__joshu_connectors__nylas_send_message (call shape: to array, subject, body - flat args).

Rules:
1. Recipients: to = ["owner@example.com", "owner.home@example.com"] (both inboxes, as array elements).
2. Subject: "Daily brief - robotics / defense / physical AI - <Mon DD>". Use the OWNER-LOCAL date.
3. Body: at most 8 items total across all lanes. Print each lane as an ALL-CAPS header in the lane order supplied, keep ROBOTICS broad with Humanoid shown as a sub-heading. Skip lanes with no items.
4. Each item: the headline on one line, the source link on its own line, then one short line starting "Why it matters:" written for the owner specifically: humanoid robotics research, a robotics venture studio, defense robotics demand, and VC deal flow in robotics and defense tech.
5. Plain ASCII text, no markdown tables, no HTML, minimal emoji. Do NOT add a signature.
